author: Marlon Chaviano
name: monorepo-packages
title: npm libraries monorepo
description: To publish several npm libraries from one repo: pnpm workspaces, builds with tsup (ESM + types), tests with Vitest, and versions and changelogs with Changesets.

verify.command: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck

instructions:
## How to work here

- Each library is a folder in `packages/` with its own `package.json`; whatever `src/index.ts` exports is its public API.
- One library uses another with `"workspace:*"`; pnpm turns it into the real version when publishing.
- Every change that should be published gets a changeset: `pnpm changeset` (pick packages and version bump). Publish with `pnpm release`.
- Before finishing: `pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck`.
